description: Practice page X-02 (pages/practice/exercises.qmd), Part 3 section: the answers and feedback values that the Part 3 specs do not hold, each recomputed here from the same engine calls as the Part 3 pages (the twelve CDE schools on the released array; the league of Part 1 and its eight units U01 to U08 under the teaching posterior; the theory book's three-unit law of ch. 19). Every other answer and mistake value of the Part 3 items is a key of a Part 3 spec or of data/numbers-cases.json. The answer tolerances are the settings.x02.* keys of settings.json; the Part 3 items add no setting. A typed answer must read as a decimal, so the answer of a fraction-valued quantity gets a decimal display here (x02.p3.tb19.pmorder.tau25.risk beside tb19.law3.tau25.r111.risk, 1/4).

x02.p3.n12.G2.note: two balanced grades of six on twelve units (both CDE cuts after position 6)

x02.p3.n12.sizes543.rel.note: from grades of sizes 5, 4 and 3 on twelve units to the strict order: every pair the grades withhold is newly stated, so nNewDisclosed = M - N

x02.p3.league.ref.note: the reference of the R-02 league view: the mean of the 30 estimates, treated as fixed

x02.p3.league.flags196.note: the league flag report at cutoff 1.96 (the same call as r02.league.flags196 in part3-r02.json)

x02.p3.league.strict.note: the strict order of the 30 estimates, which states every pair

x02.p3.league.flags196.rel.note: from the flag report to the strict order: the pairs inside a flag group are newly stated, so nNewDisclosed = M - N

x02.p3.l8.post.note: teaching posterior of U01 ... U08 (prior mean 0, SD .15; the same call as r04.l8.post in part3-r04.json)

x02.p3.l8.all.cloud.note: all 545,835 reports on the eight units (the same call as r04.l8.all.cloud)

x02.p3.l8.all.m21.note: H at N = 21, the own N of the posterior-mean quantile grades: the two neighboring vertices (N = 19 and 22), psi = 2/3 for the more-disclosing one, and H (the same value as r04.league8.all.pmtiers.H)

x02.p3.l8.all.m20.note: H at N = 20, which is the mixture of the same two vertices with the weights swapped (1/3 on the more-disclosing vertex): the X-02 mistake of giving psi to the wrong vertex

x02.p3.l8.all.m205.note: H at the midpoint N = 20.5, which is the plain average of the two vertices' E (psi = 1/2): the X-02 mistake of weighting the two vertices equally

x02.p3.tb19.e.note: theory book ch. 19 three-unit law (the same input as tb19.law3.e in part3.json)

x02.p3.tb19.pmorder.tau25.note: optimal within the order A, B, C at tau = .25: the all-withheld report (the same call as tb19.law3.pmorder.tau25.optimum)

x02.p3.cde.order.note: the posterior-mean order of theta = -p (the same call as s01.order in part3-s01.json)

x02.p3.cde.tertiles.note: the tertiles: cuts after positions 4 and 8 of the posterior-mean order (the same call as s01.tertiles)

x02.p3.cde.tertiles.tau20.note: the tertiles evaluated at tau = .20 (an evaluation of a fixed report)

x02.p3.n12.G2.s.note: share stated by two balanced grades of six on twelve units, 6/11 = n(1 - 1/G)/(n - 1)

x02.p3.n12.G2.N.note: pairs stated by two balanced grades of six on twelve units

x02.p3.n12.sizes543.withheld.note: X-02 feedback value: the pairs that grades of sizes 5, 4 and 3 withhold (10 + 6 + 3), M - N

x02.p3.league.flags196.withheld.note: X-02 feedback value: the pairs inside a flag group of the league flag report (15 + 231 + 1), M - N

x02.p3.league8.m21.lowerE.note: E of the less-disclosing neighboring vertex (N = 19; the flag report itself), given in the question

x02.p3.league8.m21.upperE.note: E of the more-disclosing neighboring vertex (N = 22), given in the question

x02.p3.league8.m20.H.note: X-02 feedback value: psi given to the less-disclosing vertex (the weights swapped)

x02.p3.league8.m205.H.note: X-02 feedback value: the plain average of the two vertices' E

x02.p3.tb19.pmorder.tau25.risk.note: 1/4 as a decimal: the smallest risk within the order A, B, C at tau = .25, the typed answer of the X-02 question on the R-03 preset tb19 (the same value as tb19.law3.tau25.r111.risk)

x02.p3.cde.tertiles.EoverM.note: X-02 feedback value: E/M of the tertiles, E divided by all 66 pairs rather than the 48 stated
